written: 2026-11-20, before any reranker score on a golden case existed
decision: the cross-encoder reranker of each dense profile and its candidate slate (D-101; docs/04 §5.1, §9)
owner_priority: best possible accuracy first; latency is measured and reported against docs/04 §9
cases: the golden DEV split's answerable cases (expectedOutcome answer|conditional with necessary units): 108. TEST is not read until the configuration is frozen, then scored once.

full_revisions.Alibaba-NLP/gte-multilingual-reranker-ba: 8215cf04918ba6f7b6a62bb44238ce2953d8831c (its modelling code: Alibaba-NLP/new-impl, revision recorded by the kernel; 40ced75c3017 on 20 Nov)

passage: nizam.storage.unit_search.Session.unit_passages: the unit's chunk context prefix, a newline, its operative nodes in printed order ('label heading text'), cut at 1,600 characters; read at the case's as_of and scope
qwen_instruction: Given a question about Pakistani law, retrieve the statutory provisions that answer it

slates.hybrid: nizam.retrieval.candidates.candidates(k=50): citations, then RRF of the lexical fusion and the dense units, INV-5 gated (as built, D-098/D-099)
slates.cited_dense: candidates(k=50, windows=False): citations, then the dense units, INV-5 gated -- no BM25 windows

profiles.gpu: slates from the 8B space (question vectors replayed, evals/precomputed_encoder.py); any model
profiles.cpu: slates from the bge-m3 space; models of at most 600M parameters only (an int8 ONNX export must run on a CPU host)

citations: units the citation fast path resolved (UnitCandidate.via_citation) keep their place first, in their order: a cited section is the user's own identifier, never a model's guess (docs/04 §2.2); the reranker orders the rest. Added before any score existed.
metrics: per case over the reranked slate: NDCG@10 with binary gains (a hit is the gold unit or a unit inside it, as in evals/lexical_benchmark.py; ideal DCG over min(|gold|, 10)), MRR@10, recall@10; recall@50 of the slate is reported (reranking 50 does not change it)
rule: 1. For each profile, score every allowed (model, slate) pair by dev NDCG@10 + MRR@10. The best pair is the candidate.
2. A cheaper pair (fewer parameters; for the same model, either slate) replaces it only if within 1 point of it on NDCG@10 AND on MRR@10.

3. A profile ships a reranker only if its chosen pair's dev NDCG@10 beats that profile's un-reranked hybrid slate with a paired bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 resamples) excluding zero; otherwise that profile serves the fused order.

4. CPU profile: the chosen model is exported to int8 ONNX; it ships if its int8 dev NDCG@10 is within 1 point of the full-precision scores. Its rerank-50 latency on this host is measured and reported against docs/04's 60 ms; if p50 exceeds 1,000 ms, the best allowed model under 1,000 ms is taken instead, by the same steps.
5. The slate chosen for the gpu profile also settles D-099's open fusion question for that profile.
6. The test split is scored once, after the configuration is frozen.
